verses.21:78: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيۡمَٰنَ إِذۡ يَحۡكُمَانِ فِي ٱلۡحَرۡثِ إِذۡ نَفَشَتۡ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكۡمِهِمۡ شَٰهِدِينَ

meaning: The root نفش (nfsh) primarily means to separate or loosen something with fingers, like cotton or wool.
en_note: Manually curated for a Quranic root occurring exactly twice.
